## About
Pineiro Auto Care is a car repair and maintenance shop in Hialeah. People come to us for brakes, oil changes and the everyday work that keeps a car running.
Our customers tell us they notice how clean the shop is, and that they appreciate having the process and the price explained. We have a 5 star rating from 1209 Google reviews, and we try to earn that every time someone pulls in.

## Services
- Brakes: Changing the brakes, done quickly, with the process and price explained to you.
- Oil change: Quick oil changes for when your car is due.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, on Saturday mornings from 7:00 to 11:30 AM.

Q: Are you open on Sunday?
A: No, the shop is closed on Sunday.

Q: Will someone explain the work and the cost?
A: Yes. Customers mention that the owner explained the process and the price.
